pr_title: Bluetooth: Audio: Improve unicast client handling of CIG
pr_body:
The CIG was improperly handled by the unicast
client. It attempted to remove the CIG when an ACL
was disconnected, and did not properly use the
cig_reconfigure function.

Signed-off-by: Emil Gydesen <emil.gydesen@nordicsemi.no>

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44307

issue_context.title: LE Audio: unicast stream/ep or ACL disconnect reset should not terminate the CIG
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The CIG, or unicast group, is a group of streams and is not directly related to any connections. The current implementation terminates the CIG once `bt_audio_stream_reset` is called. 

On ACL disconnect we call `unicast_client_ep_reset` which calls `unicast_client_reset` which calls `bt_audio_stream_reset`. Resetting a stream only terminate the CIG. 

**To Reproduce**
N/A

**Expected behavior**
When ACL disconnects we should correctly reset the endpoint and detach the stream and endpoint. However the stream should remain intact, and the CIG/unicast group should not be changed. 

**Impact**
If there's a single group with multiple streams on multiple unicast servers, then if any of those connects, we attempt to terminate the group, even if there's multiple other streams active. The impact is currently just a bad log message, as a CIG cannot be terminated with active CIS.
